title: Realized rational pullback on arbitrary trivializing stratum charts
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a finite intermediate field $E$, with $A_E=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be noetherian finite-dimensional schemes with $\ell$ invertible, and $g:Y\to X$ any scheme morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Here noetherian means a finite affine cover by spectra of noetherian rings, and finite-dimensional means a finite bound on lengths of strict chains of nonempty irreducible closed subsets. On the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] put $B_{E,W}=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}(A_E/\varpi_E^n)_W$ for $W=X,Y$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Write $\mathcal C_{W,E}=D^b_c(W,A_E)$ for the integral derived-complete constructible category including compatible etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Let $\widehat P_{g,E}$ be the specified quotient-tower completed pullback, with its completion unit $\gamma_{g,K}:B_{E,Y}\otimes^L_{g^{-1}B_{E,X}}g^{-1}K\to\widehat P_{g,E}K$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback].

Put $E_W=B_{E,W}[1/\varpi_E]$ and let $J_W:\mathcal C_{W,E}[1/\varpi_E]\xrightarrow{\sim}D^b_{\mathrm{cons}}(W_{\mathrm{proet}},E_W)$ be continuous rational realization [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization, def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Let $F$ be a constructible $E_X$-module sheaf, meaning locally finite free on a finite locally closed stratification [def-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-module, def-constructible-stratification], and $K$ an object of the raw rationalization equipped with $J_XK\cong F[0]$. Let $\overline P_{g,E}$ be the fraction extension of $\widehat P_{g,E}$ and put $G_g(M)=E_Y\otimes^L_{g^{-1}E_X}g^{-1}M$. For any locally closed immersion $i:S\hookrightarrow X$ on which $F$ is locally finite free, set $S'=Y\times_XS$, with projections $i':S'\to Y$ and $g_S:S'\to S$. There is a natural isomorphism in the derived category
$$i'{}^*J_Y(\overline P_{g,E}K)\cong G_{g_S}(F|_S[0]).$$
For every pro-etale chart $u:U\to S$ with a trivialization $F|_U\cong E_U^r$, put $U'=S'\times_SU$ and let $g_U:U'\to U$. Restriction of the displayed isomorphism to $U'$ identifies both sides with $E_{U'}^r[0]$. Here continuous coefficient sheaves on arbitrary chart schemes are the continuous-function sheaves of [lem-per-continuous-coefficient-slice-normalization]; no noetherian hypothesis on $U,U'$ is imposed. The identification is the canonical balanced-tensor map
$$e'\otimes(e_1,\ldots,e_r)\longmapsto(e'g_U^\sharp(e_1),\ldots,e'g_U^\sharp(e_r)),$$
with inverse given on a basis vector by $a e_j\mapsto a\otimes e_j$. Thus $i'{}^*J_Y(\overline P_{g,E}K)$ is concentrated in degree zero. These comparisons use the finite-quotient normalized structural maps and ambient derived composition and slice restriction; they include $r=0$ and empty $S'$, without any flatness hypothesis on $g^{-1}E_X\to E_Y$.

proof.text: Obtain normalized Pull counits for the immersion, both projections and their composites. Pointwise normalization and injectivity of the ring adjunction identify the supplied Along coefficient with the actual continuous pullback. Obtain both normalized Composition records. The immersion coefficient map is invertible and single computation gives exactInclusion. Assemble Stratum from these records.

Apply single computation to the finite locally free restricted F. Compose Stratum.comparison with this single isomorphism to identify the realized pulled-back K with an ordinary module in degree zero. Transfer both standard derived bounds through this isomorphism.

For each chart U obtain its ambient Pull counits and both normalized compositions. Slice transport identifies its coefficient map with an isomorphism, and single computation gives exactChart. The balanced finite-free theorem gives an ordinary isomorphism and both section formulas. Its finite free source is finite locally free by the canonical generating sections; single computation supplies computes. Assemble FreeModel and Chart. No realization on a chart is used.
